programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Rayo Vallecano - Valencia 21.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League: Bodo Glimt - LASK
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet.

Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League: Slavia - Villarreal
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet.

programme.title: Fudbal - UEFA Konferencijska liga: Brighton - U. Craiova
programme.desc: Od 2021. godine ljubitelji fudbala uživaju Ligi Konferencija koju organizuje UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane timove državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dva dijela, nakon kojih u takmičenje ulaze 32 tima koji su podijeljeni u osam grupa po četiri. 16 timova napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale.

programme.title: Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Juventus - Omonia
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation UEFE from 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. From that season, the competition was officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a group stage was introduced followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and she confronts him when she finds herself pregnant.

programme.title: To Kill A Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Roving swordsman Tu Meng-Fei chances to rescue a female pupil Mu Wan-Erh and later, another girl Li Sai-Nan from underworld leader Leng Tien-Lei. Li wants to take vengeance on Leng who murdered her parents.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: In Pale Passion, Chin Ping-hsings only directed film, the gorgeous Chiang Li-ping plays a scorned wife Ah Hsia in an unsettling tale about cheating, adultery and blatant abuse, which develops into a deadly love triangle.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: A sickly wife and maid conspire to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: An unparalleled kung-fu masterpiece from the one and only Chang Cheh. The dying Poison Clan master sends his last pupil on a dangerous mission to hunt down the five titular warriors.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: Chou Lian Huan is good at fist fighting in Shanghai. In order to please a hostess named Chen Ju Fang, he is willing to sacrifice everything and fight against the son of the gang leader in Shanghai.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My 12 Lovers?
programme.desc: Six guitar playing, rock and roll singing and dancing young people on a boating trip are stranded on a rural island off of Hong Kong during a typhoon. They become suspicious of a woman (Jenny Hu) who matches the radio bulletin description of a murderess who killed twelve men. Can she be trusted? Is she laying a trap for a local youth (Chin Han) housesitting a mansion?

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: When an Anti-Ching chief is killed, his family flees to a small town populated by quarreling students and formidable gym coaches. However, one teacher is also an undercover agent.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Cheng-ying and his sister ingratiate themselves into the life of the diabolical Lin Hao, as they plot to avenge their father's death, with a little help from the lethal titular move.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs to teach her martial arts skills.

programme.title: The Knight Of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber Of Shaolin
programme.desc: An award-winning film in 1978. Liu Yu-Te escapes to Shaolin Temple, mastered the skill of 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers. Succeeded his revenge and introduced the 36th Chamber.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life!

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: Chang Cheh directs an early incarnation of Ti Lung's lone swordsman in this kung-fu classic. King Eagle crosses blades with the Tongs after falling for Li Ching's beautiful Chief.

programme.title: Carry On Doctors And Nurses
programme.desc: Director Chan Friend created this delightful variation on the British 'Carry On!' film series. It can certainly make you laugh with all the comical acts happened in the Hospital!

programme.title: The Bride From Hell
programme.desc: The 70s idol Hsing Hui and Yon Fan star in this horror movie. Young business man marries pretty, young bride, never knowing that she carries the spirit and everything starts there.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Kuo Tsing wins the hand of fair maiden Huang Yung. Almost immediately, however, clan rivalries leads to Kuo being wounded by Ouyang Feng and Huang being named new leader of the Beggar Clan.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Lo Wei helms this poetic romance that proves a perfect showcase for Ivy Ling Po's incredible talents, as a young scholar manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li stars in the story of two students looking to persuade their parents to bless their marriage. The lovebirds hatch what they think is a foolproof plan: they play dead!

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: A heroic family is double crossed and massacred on the battle field with only two of the brothers surviving the slaughter. One of them escapes to a Shaolin temple and the vengeance puts him at odds with the monks.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: As the roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collected proofs of corruption from the officials, they demanded to become the governor of the country.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: Wang Yu plays a noble martial arts student, whose master and peers are murdered by Lo Lieh's bloodthirsty karate expert, and embarks on a tough training regime to avenge them.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: In the waning day of the Ching Dynasty, the son of the local magistrate murdered a peddler and raped his wife. The wife had been framed for her husband's murder by the rapist.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: A gang of unemployed martial artists seem to have their bad fortunes.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. The union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Danny Lee, Jason Pai and Sun Chien play newly-recruited law enforcers whose crime-fighting is hampered by their corrupt superiors, in this period-set martial arts thriller.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: It's a no-holds-barred battle to the death for possession of the invaluable Purple Sword. Assistant director Wang Po-yi also wrote this entertaining and exciting adventure.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Tang Peng Nan are a sweet couple. She sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan at a time when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by him, leading to their break up.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport vampires for a living. When two of them hopped away, it is revealed that one of them is actually a man in disguise trying to escape from his enemies.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: After his hit directorial debut Let's Make Laugh, Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns with this comedic clash of cultures when a Mainland Chinese peasant takes his family to Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: The evil minister uses the twelve golden medallions, the highest imperial decree, to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: Call Of The Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: Anita Yuan Yung-yi stars as an illegitimate daughter who inadvertently finds a pearl with a genie in it. Michael Wong is the genie who gives her three wishes, leading to a lot of hilarity and even a little heartbreak.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs 2 (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: In this prequel to Mou gaan dou (2002), Chan Wing Yan has just become an undercover cop in the triads while Lau Kin Ming joins the police force. Both the triads and the police find an enemy in a rival crime boss.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actor tries to convince a lady to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series, but unbeknownst to him, she really is a witch!

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission. But his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Chow stars as Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: As a man leaves his wife and daughter, a series of brief conversations, observed gestures, chance encounters and impulsive acts, tell the story of the relationships that flounder and thrive in the wake of this decision.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. Freaked out by the haunting, the security guards invite ghostbuster Leo and his assistant to help.

programme.title: Whisper Of Silent Body
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qin works with his assistant and the police captain to resolve the backlog of cases.

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: A cop relies on a young car thief to take down four gangsters, who plan to rob a rich merchant for a large amount of money.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father is exposed.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: Drunken Master (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Wong Fei-Hung is a mischievous, yet righteous young man, but after a series of incidents, his frustrated father has him disciplined by a master of drunken martial arts.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: How To Pick Girls Up!
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: A Hong Kong taxi driver's life horribly falls apart after accidentally hitting a sorcerer with his cab. He decides to seek the sorcerer's help to turn the curse on his enemies at the expense of his own life.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This film tells the story of a Chinese illegal immigrant, Cheung Kwan-chow, and his journey in New York.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: A frustrated young man afflicted with polio works as a paralegal for a corrupt lawyer. He gets passed onto him the technique for a strange power by a dying man, which turns him into an oil based superhero/villain.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire
programme.desc: The planned reburial of a town elder goes awry as the corpse resurrects into a hopping, bloodthirsty vampire, targeting everyone responsible for digging the grave. A Taoist Priest and his two disciples attempt to stop the terror.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: The story is about a powerful drug-lord in southeast Asia, and the good guys have to save their loved ones under the threat of the Drug business conspiracy.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: A man received a haunted mail predicting his death. A man mourns the death of his beloved wife. Three brothers clashes over dinner.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: The film revolves around a woman in her late twenties who rediscovers her talent for boxing after a long hiatus. She unexpectedly meets her former boxing coach and the pair work together to help her reach the final rounds of professional boxing matches.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 3
programme.desc: Police officer Chow Sing Sing is assigned to work undercover investigating the murder of millionaire Million Wong, to whom Chow has an uncanny resemblance, by posing as an amnesiac Wong.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Action superstar Chow Yun-Fat portrays real-life gangster Chen Daqi as he rises to the upper echelons of power, finding himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh 2
programme.desc: The cheating husband goes bankrupt, and his house is soon to be taken by the government. A security guard is assigned to guard it while the husband goes missing. However, only the mistress stays alone in the house. Will the lonely, handsome guard and the heartbroken mistress hook up?

programme.title: Look For A Star
programme.desc: Inspired by the relationship between Stanly Ho and his fourth wife, Angela, it's a romantic comedy about a billonaire who falls in love with a feisty casino dealer.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Action adventure in which the formula for a cancer-curing medicine is stolen, and a kung-fu fighting team must overcome rivals and doublecrosses in order to get it back

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: The Sorcerer And The White Snake
programme.desc: A master monk tries to protect a naive young physician from a thousand-year-old snake demon. A contest of psychic powers results in mayhem.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: The young emperor Kangxi is attempting to select a bride. His mother has arranged for young available women to visit him so that he may choose.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. His pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Grave robbers unearth preserved vampires. Transporting child vampire, its spell breaks, befriending locals. Parent vampires awaken, escape. Herbalist pursues to destroy them.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: A priest discovers that the water supply in his village has been contaminated by bats, and while in the process of digging a well to find new water supply, he inadvertently unearths the corpse of an evil Western priest.

programme.title: Spin the Bottle
programme.desc: Saat teman-teman bermain putar botol di sebuah rumah yang bekas lokasi pembantaian, mereka melepaskan roh jahat dan mulai mati dengan cara yang mengerikan.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Profesor Oldman meyakinkan empat remaja untuk bermalam di sebuah rumah angker. Tapi sesampainya di sana, berbagai situasi aneh mulai terjadi, dan mereka memutuskan untuk menyingkirkan hantu tersebut.

programme.title: Dangerous Game: The Legacy Murders
programme.desc: Reuni keluarga di sebuah rumah terpencil berubah menjadi mematikan ketika mereka terjebak di dalam dan dipaksa memainkan permainan bertahan hidup yang mematikan.

programme.title: Nobody 2
programme.desc: Hutch Mansell, seorang ayah di pinggiran kota yang dulunya adalah seorang pembunuh bayaran mematikan, terseret kembali ke masa lalunya yang penuh kekerasan setelah menggagalkan upaya perampokan rumah, yang memicu serangkaian peristiwa.

programme.title: Pu-239
programme.desc: Seorang pekerja di pembangkit listrik tenaga nuklir Rusia mencuri sejumlah kecil plutonium tingkat senjata dan mencoba menjualnya di pasar gelap Moskow.

programme.title: Changing Lanes
programme.desc: Momen keegoisan dan percikan amarah akan menyebabkan dua pria melampaui batas antara benar dan salah, baik dan jahat, amarah dan penebusan.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Pahlawan terhebat di dunia menjadi musuh terganas saat Optimus Prime meluncurkan misi untuk menyelamatkan Cybertron dengan menghancurkan Bumi.

programme.title: Run All Night
programme.desc: Setelah membunuh putra seorang mafia, seorang pembunuh bayaran tua harus menjaga agar putranya yang terasing itu tetap hidup selama satu malam setelah ditandai untuk dibunuh oleh mafia.

programme.title: Seven
programme.desc: Dua orang polisi dihadapkan dengan situasi yang mengerikan saat seorang pembunuh psikopat menggunakan tujuh dosa besar sebagai modus operandi dalam pembunuhannya.

programme.title: Life Support
programme.desc: Kisah seorang wanita HIV-positif yang mempelajari pelajaran cinta dan kekuatan dengan membantu orang lain.

programme.title: The Gathering Storm
programme.desc: Tahun-tahun Winston Churchill yang liar sebelum Perang Dunia II, ketika hanya dia yang dapat melihat ancaman yang ditimbulkan Adolf Hitler dan Jerman yang dipersenjatai kembali terhadap Eropa.

programme.title: Daddy's Home 2
programme.desc: Dusty dan Brad bekerjasama untuk memberi anak-anak mereka pengalaman Natal yang sempurna. Namun, situasi berubah saat ayah-ayah mereka tiba dan mengacaukan liburan.

programme.title: The Good Liar
programme.desc: Seorang penipu ulung mengincar korban terbarunya – seorang wanita yang baru saja menjanda, dengan kekayaan jutaan dolar. Namun, saat keduanya semakin dekat, apa yang seharusnya menjadi penipuan sederhana berubah menjadi pertaruhan yang sangat besar.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Seorang penyidik nan eksentrik dikirim ke Sleepy Hollow untuk menyelidiki serangkaian pembunuhan aneh yang menyebabkan beberapa orang ditemukan tewas di dalam hutan.

programme.title: Blade
programme.desc: Seorang pria setengah vampir dan setengah manusia menjadi pelindung ras manusia dengan berusaha memerangi vampir-vampir jahat.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa
programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Borussia Mönchengladbach - Borussia Dortmund
programme.desc: Borussia Dortmund przed 10. kolejką ma na koncie 21 punktów - tyle samo co lider, Bayern Monachium. Obie ekipy będą faworytami swoich kolejnych spotkań. Dortmundczycy zmierzą się z zamykającą tabelę Borussią Mönchengladbach. Będzie to dla nich szansa na rewanż za ostatnie bezpośrednie starcie, w którym przegrali 0:1.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Juventus FC - Venezia FC
programme.desc: Stara Dama nie ustrzegła się wpadek w trwającej kampanii Serie A. Przegrała na przykład z Genoą 0:2 oraz Sassuolo 2:3. Strata punktów w spotkaniu z najsłabszą drużyną w lidze, Venezią FC, byłaby sensacją.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole VfL Wolfsburg
programme.desc: Edin Dżeko, Grafite, a także Andrzej Juskowiak to tylko trzech wybitnych napastników, którzy zdobywali gole w barwach Wolfsburga. W szeregach tej drużyny występowało bowiem wielu klasowych snajperów. W programie zobaczymy najładniejsze bramki zdobyte przez piłkarzy Wilków.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica
programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

programme.title: Birds of paradise
programme.desc: Filmowcy i dziennikarze zebrali w jednym miejscu ciekawostki dotyczące Bundesligi. Każdy znajdzie w tym filmie coś dla siebie, niemiecka liga bowiem to nie tylko sport, ale ogromne przedsięwzięcie dotykające różnych dziedzin życia takich jak ekonomia, socjologia moda i wiele innych.

programme.desc: US Sassuolo Calcio czeka na ligowe zwycięstwo od ponad dwóch miesięcy. W ostatnich siedmiu spotkaniach zanotowało sześć porażek i jeden remis. Po tej niekorzystnej serii doszło do zmiany na ławce trenerskiej - z posadą pożegnał się Alberto Aquilani, a jego miejsce zajął Roberto D'Aversa. Pod jego wodzą zawodnicy Sassuolo zmierzą się u siebie z Genoą CFC. Goście mają za sobą porażkę 1:2 z AC Milan.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: RC Lens - Toulouse FC

programme.title: AJ Auxerre - Małe miasto, wielki klub
programme.desc: Opowieść o AJ Auxerre. Klub został założony w 1905 roku w niewielkim mieście w Burgundii. Mimo lokalizacji z dala od metropolii przez lata rzucał wyzwanie tuzom francuskiego futbolu. Największy sukces odniósł w 1996 roku, gdy został mistrzem Ligue 1.

programme.desc: US Sassuolo Calcio czeka na ligowe zwycięstwo od ponad dwóch miesięcy. W ostatnich siedmiu spotkaniach zanotowało sześć porażek i jeden remis. Po tej niekorzystnej serii doszło do zmiany na ławce trenerskiej - z posadą pożegnał się Alberto Aquilani, a jego miejsce zajął Roberto D'Aversa. Pod jego wodzą zawodnicy Sassuolo zmierzą się u siebie z Genoą CFC. Goście mają za sobą porażkę 1:2 z AC Milan.

W programie przyjrzymy się sylwetkom łowców bramek i oczywiście najpiękniejszym golom w ich bogatych kolekcjach.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole VfB Stuttgart
programme.desc: Widzowie zobaczą najładniejsze gole strzelone przez piłkarzy VfB Stuttgart. W programie nie zabraknie m.in. trafień z sezonu 2006/2007, na zakończenie którego Die Roten zdobyli mistrzostwo Bundesligi.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Vitoria SC - FC Porto
programme.desc: FC Porto nadal może pochwalić się kompletem zwycięstw w lidze. Ma ich już na koncie 10, a w poprzednim meczu pokonało Estoril 4:0. O przedłużenie tej imponującej serii podopieczni Francesco Farioliego powalczą w 11. kolejce na wyjeździe z Vitorią SC.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: ESTAC Troyes - Le Havre AC
programme.desc: Walczący o wydostanie się ze strefy spadkowej gospodarze goszczą czerwoną latarnię rozgrywek. Le Havre w dotychczasowych dziesięciu seriach gier nie odniósł jeszcze zwycięstwa, zdobywając dwa punkty za remisy. Troyes spisywało się nieco lepiej, notując dwie wygrane i dwa remisy.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Monza - ACF Fiorentina
programme.desc: AC Monza w poprzedniej kolejce musiała uznać wyższość Atalanty BC, przegrywając 0:1. Dla Biancorossich była to już czwarta ligowa porażka z rzędu. Przełamania będą teraz szukać w starciu z ACF Fiorentiną, choć zadanie nie wydaje się łatwe. Mimo że Fioletowi mieli w tym sezonie swoje problemy, ostatnio punktowali w trzech kolejnych spotkaniach, notując dwa remisy i zwycięstwo.

programme.desc: Jedynym ligowym zwycięstwem FC Schalke 04 w tym sezonie pozostaje to odniesione we wrześniu nad Unionem Berlin. Ostatnie mecze podopiecznych Mirona Muslicia to niemal wyłącznie porażki. Po dziewięciu kolejkach mają na koncie zaledwie sześć punktów, a o kolejne powalczą przed własną publicznością w starciu z VfB Stuttgart. Goście z kolei postarają się o trzecie ligowe zwycięstwo z rzędu.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Paris FC - Angers SCO
programme.desc: Paris FC jest największą niespodzianką tegorocznych zmagań. Obecnie znajduje się na trzeciej lokacie i traci zaledwie 3 oczka do liderującego PSG. Zbliżyć się do lokalnego rywala może starciem z walczącym o utrzymanie Angers.

programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa
programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.

programme.title: HHH - Hamburger SV
programme.desc: Widzowie zobaczą historię jednego z najważniejszych zespołów niemieckiej piłki. Hamburger SV sześć razy zdobywał tytuł mistrza Niemiec. Aktualnie drużyna gra w 2. Bundeslidze i stara się wrócić do elity niemieckiej piłki klubowej.

programme.title: Najlepsi pomocnicy Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Thomas Haessler, Christian Ziege, Mehmet Scholl, Stefan Effenberg, Andreas Moller... w latach 90. po boiskach niemieckiej Bundesligi biegało wielu świetnych pomocników. Piłkarze grający na tej pozycji walnie przyczynili się do sukcesów reprezentacji Niemiec w ostatniej dekadzie XX wieku.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica
programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

programme.desc: Kencana menyelidiki pembunuhan ayahnya yang ternyata melibatkan Hardiman, pengusaha sukses yang ternyata juga memiliki hubungan dengannya. Dalam prosesnya, Kencana bekerja sama dengan Glen, yang juga menyimpan dendam terhadap Hardiman atas kematian kakaknya dan pencurian desainnya. Keduanya berusaha membongkar kejahatan Hardiman, di tengah konflik keluarga, persaingan bisnis, dan kisah cinta yang tumbuh di antara mereka.

programme.title: Tertulis Untuk Kita (RCTI)
programme.desc: Ketika dua hati dipertemukan, sementara masa lalu belum usai dan masa depan penuh akan tanda tanya. Ada rahasia yang tersimpan, luka yang terpendam, dan takdir yang tak bisa dihindari. Akankah pertemuan mereka membawa kebahagiaan atau justru menghadirkan luka baru?

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Terikat Janji (RCTI)
programme.desc: Davina terluka karena pengkhianatan cinta dan hidupnya hancur. Ia kemudian menjalin hubungan pura-pura dengan Sena. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keduanya benar-benar jatuh cinta, namun harus menghadapi rahasia dan konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Terbaik Itu Kamu (RCTI)
programme.desc: Sera harus menanggung kesalahan yang tidak pernah ia perbuat, sementara Kenzi menyimpan rasa bersalah atas kejadian yang mengubah hidup Sera. Saat kebenaran mulai terungkap, apakah semuanya masih bisa diperbaiki?

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Terbelenggu Rindu Amira

programme.title: Terbelenggu Rindu Amira
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Amira perempuan cantik, baik hati, dan selalu positif dalam memandang hidup. Kehidupannya berjalan baik-baik saja namun setelah kematian suami dan putrinya serta masalah yang datang bertubi-tubi membuatnya menjadi semakin terpuruk untuk melanjutkan hidupnya.
